purpose: Compare reviewer signal, false positives, quota availability, and exact-head coverage on one controlled pull request.

defect_cases.expected_signal: Public HTTPS client disables certificate verification without an explicit operator opt-out.
A scanner gate validates only the report root and accepts malformed nested findings.
One permissive parser accepts both source X.Y.Z and published vX.Y.Z contracts.
Cancellation kills only the shell parent and can orphan its child process.
URL validation resolves a host separately from the HTTP connection.
A test asserts against the last globally captured subprocess call instead of its owned invocation.
Persisted security metadata claims a strict preset while effective axes are unfenced.

benign_controls.must_not_report: Command injection when subprocess uses a fixed argv list with shell disabled and no external input.
Unfinished production code when TODO text exists only inside a generator template.
Unconditional TLS bypass when insecure mode is an explicit operator option and secure mode is the default.
Unused import when the import is an intentional, documented compatibility re-export.
